record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Six units declare SOAK: Poliwag (1 star), Poliwhirl (2), Politoed (3) and Tatsugiri Curly/Droopy/Stretchy (1 star each). The strategy is shared; unit differences are star count (table index), range and maxPP. Poliwhirl declares passive TADPOLE and the Tatsugiri forms COMMANDER; those passives are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by stars) to the cast target only, then gives every unit on the caster's team, the caster included, +10 PP. The PP gain is not scaled by AP or crit, and each unit's own silence / protect / fatigue / no-PP-gain / resurrecting state can block or reduce it.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target; PP: every unit of the caster's team on the board (caster included)
targeting.note: The team loop has no range or self filter. Ally PP is added immediately after the damage call in the same process.

geometry.shape: single target for damage; whole team for PP (no geometry)

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

effects.target: every unit of the caster's team, caster included
effects.resolution: addPP rounds, halves under fatigue, ignores a positive gain while silenced, protected, under NO_PP_GAIN or resurrecting, and clamps PP to 0..2*maxPP-1; twist-band hook (not read)

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (160) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. The PP gain (10) does not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None for the PP gain (whole team). The damage target is the cast target chosen before the cast.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast repeats the damage and the team PP gain.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 20/40/80 (1/2/3 stars) to the target, +10 PP to each team unit. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers. PP gain is flat 10 (rounded), subject to the PP gate states listed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers)
